title: Customer checks out at a server-computed total

card.i_want: to review my cart, address, coupon, shipping and net total before paying
card.so_that: I pay exactly what the merchant computed and not a value that was altered on the way

intent: The merchant can stand behind the number the customer pays, which is what makes the storefront a real sales channel rather than a quotation form.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a server-computed total with a coupon and shipping
given: a cart with a pre-discount subtotal of 1200 THB
an active coupon worth 100 THB and an address belonging to the customer
then: the server computes 1200 minus 100 plus 60 shipping, a total of 1160 THB
an order is created in awaiting-payment with its stock reserved

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: shipping is free exactly at the threshold
given: a cart with a pre-discount subtotal of exactly 1500 THB

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: shipping is charged just below the threshold
given: a cart with a pre-discount subtotal of 1499 THB

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: the threshold is read before the discount, not after
given: a cart with a pre-discount subtotal of 1600 THB and a 200 THB coupon
then: shipping is 0 THB because 1600 is at or above the threshold
the total is 1400 THB and not 1460 THB

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a discount larger than the goods total floors at zero
given: a cart with a subtotal of 80 THB and a coupon worth 100 THB
then: the goods component is 0 THB and never negative
no money is returned to the customer

given: an order that already has one coupon applied
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer enters a second coupon code
then: the second coupon is refused with a neutral message

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a coupon that expired while the customer browsed is caught at confirm
given: a coupon that was valid when the checkout page rendered and expired before confirm
then: the confirm is refused with the neutral message that the coupon is no longer valid
no order is created and no stock is reserved

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a coupon at its per-customer quota is refused
given: a customer who has already used this coupon its permitted number of times
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer applies it again and confirms
then: the confirm is refused and the quota is not exceeded

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an address belonging to another customer is refused
given: an address id that belongs to a different customer
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer confirms the order against it
then: no field of the other customer's address appears in the response

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an empty cart cannot be confirmed
given: a cart with no line items
then: the confirm is refused and no order is created

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a double-clicked confirm yields exactly one order
given: a confirm already accepted for this idempotency key
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer confirms again with the same key
then: the original order is returned unchanged
no second order, reservation or charge exists

given: any confirm that creates an order
then: an audit event records the event, actor, time, order id, total and audit id

pii_fields.justification: the chosen shipping address is a direct identifier snapshotted onto the order
pii_fields.treatment: snapshotted into the order; redacted in non-order logs

audit_events.justification: order creation is a financial event

idempotency.justification: a double-clicked confirm must not create a second order, reservation or charge

reversibility.justification: a confirm that fails downstream must release the stock it reserved
reversibility.compensating_action: release the stock reserved by this confirm

authn_authz.justification: the cart and the chosen address must both belong to the confirming customer

regulatory.justification: the Consumer Protection Act and the Electronic Transactions Act require the total be shown before payment

tipping_off.justification: no suspicious-activity or sanctions context in retail checkout

edge_case_ledger.justification: all derivations for a constraint of this shape were written

cases_written: pre-discount reading at 1600 with a coupon
edge_case_ledger.justification: the three threshold positions plus the ordering case the rule's wording turns on
the eligibility checks read state the confirm itself then locks, so the race lives in RULE-STOCK-05 where it is covered
an idempotency key is an identity, not a magnitude, so it has no boundary
the limit of one is the rule itself; zero and one are the happy and refused cases already written

cases_written: discount exceeding the goods total, floored at zero
edge_case_ledger.justification: the calculation is evaluated inside the single confirm transaction
re-validation reads one store and commits with the order
